fr.sorbonne_u.components.tasks_management.interfaces

Interface AbnormalTerminationNotificationCI

  • All Superinterfaces:
    ComponentInterface, OfferedCI, java.rmi.Remote, RequiredCI
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    AbnormalTerminationNotificationConnector, AbnormalTerminationNotificationInboundPort, AbnormalTerminationNotificationOutboundPort

    public interface AbnormalTerminationNotificationCI
extends OfferedCI, RequiredCI
    The component interface AbnormalTerminationNotificationCI declares the signature of services used to notify client components of abnormal termination of their asynchronous service calls.

    Description

    Invariants

     invariant       true        // no more invariant

    Created on : 2026-03-13

    Author:
    Jacques Malenfant

    • Method Detail

      • notifyAbnormalTermination

        void notifyAbnormalTermination(java.lang.Class<? extends OfferedCI> offeredInterface,
                               java.lang.String serviceInboundPortURI,
                               java.lang.String serviceName,
                               java.io.Serializable[] actualParameters,
                               java.lang.Throwable t)
                        throws java.lang.Exception
        notify a caller component the abnormal termination of a service call on the callee.

        Contract

         pre     offeredInterface != null
 pre     inboundPortURI != null && !inboundPortURI.isEmpty()
 pre     serviceName != null && !serviceName.isEmpty()
 pre     actualParameters != null
 pre     t != null
 post    true        // no postcondition.
        Parameters:
        offeredInterface - offered interface under which the service was called.
        serviceInboundPortURI - URI of the inbound port offering offeredInterface.
        serviceName - name of the called service (signature).
        actualParameters - actual parameters passed to the service.
        t - throwable thrown during the execution of the task.
        Throws:
        java.lang.Exception - to do.
